fullContent:
Swarna Vanga 
 Reference: Rasamruta 3/95 – 100 
 Swarna Vanga is an Ayurvedic medicine, with herbal and mineral ingredients, in powder / tablet form. It is used in Ayurvedic treatment of chronic cough, bronchitis, asthma, etc. This medicine should only be taken strictly under medical supervision. It Balances Vata, Pitta and Kapha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Vanga Bhasma – Bhasma of Tin – 144 g 
 Shuddha Parada – Purified and processed Mercury – 72 g 
 Nimbu Swarasa – Lemon juice extract – quantity sufficient 
 Navasadara – Purified Ammonium chloride – 72 g 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified and processed Sulphur – 72 g 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 It is prepared with a special Kupipakwa technique i.e. heating of all ingredients with kajjali (sulphur and mercury). 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic cold 
 Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 Diabetes 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 125 mg once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is traditionally administered along with honey or warm water. 
 Side Effects 
 
 This medicine should be taken only under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous. 
 This medicine should be avoided in children and pregnant and lactating mothers. 
 Overdose may cause many poisonous side effects. 
 Take this medicine in pre cise doses and for a limited period of time, as advised by the doctor. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
